subject: Forecast tiers recode — seller readiness checklist & training
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast tiers recode — seller readiness checklist & training

Team,

Quick heads-up: Finance + Sales Ops have finalized a small but important recode of our forecast categories — this affects how deals should be classified in the CRM across Commit / Best Case / Pipeline. The goal is to reduce ambiguity at quarter close and improve accuracy for capacity planning and revenue recognition.

High-level changes (summary):
- Commit: now requires (1) signed SOW or contract in legal status AND (2) customer confirmation of go-live date within the quarter.
- Best Case: validated technical + procurement alignment, legal review started, but no signature yet.
- Pipeline: all active opportunities that lack the above two checkpoints.

Attached: seller_readiness_deck.pptx (short walk-through) and forecast_tiers_recode_checklist.pdf (one-page checklist). Please review before the quick training sessions we scheduled.

Training options (pick one):
- Apr 2, 2028 10:00–11:00 PT (Americas focus)
- Apr 5, 2028 08:00–09:00 PT (EMEA-friendly time)

Action items for sellers and managers:
1) Update all active deals with expected close dates and current category following the checklist by EOD Apr 6.
2) Add a single-line rationale in the deal notes when moving an opportunity into Commit.
3) If a deal is borderline, mark it Best Case and add the outstanding checklist items.

Why this matters: small definitional drift today causes large forecast noise at month-end — this will reduce churn between Sales and Finance and make our monthly variance explanations cleaner.

If you have any complex cases (enterprise renewals, multi-region procurements), flag them to me and Marissa and we will triage.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: seller_readiness_deck.pptx (pptx), forecast_tiers_recode_checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast tiers recode — seller readiness checklist & training

Thanks Jonas — quick clarifying question: for Commit you mentioned ‘customer confirmation of go-live date within the quarter’ — how do you want us to handle deals where the customer has verbally committed but legal redlines are still in cycle? In our EMEA pipeline that’s ~6 deals that sellers think are locked.

Also: is there an expected change to our HubSpot pipeline reporting (fields renamed) or is this purely a sales process change? If reporting changes are coming, I’ll need that timeline to update the weekly export.

— Lauren
VP, Sales (Mid-Market)
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:20:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast tiers recode — seller readiness checklist & training

Ack — will cascade to EMEA sellers in our Friday standup. For borderline verbal-commit deals, sellers will mark Best Case and include the checklist items; we won’t move to Commit until legal has at least an executed SOW or an email from the customer confirming the go-live date.

-Markus
Senior Sales Manager, EMEA
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@helixlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 12:15:05 -0700
Subject: RE: Forecast tiers recode — seller readiness checklist & training

Jonas — Samantha here on the Helix account. We’ve got an upcoming renewal conversation and our renewals team asks whether this recode will change how you guys report our renewal in your forecast. Should we expect any change in the way Redwood classifies renewals vs. new logo opportunities? The renewal is planned for mid-April and our procurement/legal timeline is on track.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Renewals
Helix Labs
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@helixlabs.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Forecast tiers recode — seller readiness checklist & training

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and great question. Renewals are treated the same under the recode: if you (the customer) provide written confirmation of the renewal terms or there is an executed renewal order/SOW and the go-live/renewal effective date falls inside the quarter, the deal can be moved to Commit.

If you’ve only had verbal agreement but legal has not provided a signature yet, we ask sellers to mark the opportunity Best Case and note the outstanding items (e.g., legal signature pending). The checklist/practical examples attached include renewal-specific guidance on pages 4–5.

Lauren — to answer your earlier question: no immediate CRM field renames are required — this is a process-level change. We will publish a HubSpot field-mapping doc next week only if reporting changes are necessary after the first reconciliation. For now, please continue using the same pipeline fields but follow the checklist for category selection. HubSpot reference: HS-6784123.

Next steps:
- Sellers update deals by EOD Apr 6.
- Training recordings and the two doc attachments are in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cChecklist
- I’ll run a short QA session Apr 7 9:00 PT for any remaining edge cases — invite to follow.

Thanks everyone — marking this one closed unless there are escalations.

Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: seller_readiness_deck.pptx (pptx), forecast_tiers_recode_checklist.pdf (pdf)
